sepaCountries.source: EPC409-09 EPC List of Countries in the SEPA Schemes' Geographical Scope, version 8.0, 24 December 2025 (41 countries), plus territories that are part of a listed country (Åland, French overseas departments and collectivities in SEPA) and the Crown Dependencies listed with the United Kingdom

eeaCountries.source: European Economic Area: the 27 EU member states, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway Plus territories that are part of an EEA country (Åland; the French outermost regions GF, GP, MQ, RE, YT and Saint-Martin), added 2026-11-18.

eeaCurrencies.source: Official currencies of EEA countries (EUR, and the national currencies of EEA countries outside the euro area; CHF as the currency of Liechtenstein)
